signs: Thinks only the government can protect forests

end.summary:
Discussed how trees provide birds with shelter and food, clean air, and support animals.
Practised traditional nature-protecting examples: Bishnoi, sacred groves, and neem leaves for grain storage.
Connected roots with holding soil and helping water reach springs.
Bishnoi and neem examples were stated correctly in some attempts; the neem comparison remained uncertain at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Dev practised linking traditional practices with nature and science, using reasons such as shelter, food, soil-holding roots, and insects being kept away from grain. They gave the Bishnoi and sacred grove examples and explained neem leaves using a familiar household practice. Dev mixed up which grain container would have fewer insects, and this was not corrected by the end of the lesson. At home, compare two labelled containers—one with neem leaves and one without—and discuss which should have fewer insects and why.
